buyer_persona.name: Ilse Varga
buyer_persona.role: Director of facilities for a portfolio of 14 mid-sized office and clinic buildings
priorities: Cut comfort complaints across all sites
Lower HVAC energy spend without replacing equipment
Pass the corporate IT security review on the first attempt
Keep installation disruption to evenings and weekends
objections: What will this cost per building, including sensors and installation?
Which buildings like ours already run it? I want to call a reference.
Is the platform ISO 27001 certified? Our IT team requires it.
Our chillers are fifteen years old. Will it actually talk to them?
What happens to the building if your cloud goes down?
language: I can't be on every floor
the BMS guy charges us every time
IT will want a security pack
one screen for all my sites
